name: Autumn Days
source:
Autumn is a really pretty time so you were hoping to see Autumn in a prettier light! So you're working a job to afford a ticket to the Autumn Lights Show. During your quick hustle for money you may find yourself surrounded with two new friends.

[From [url=https://fatimatorres.itch.io/autumn-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
秋天是个格外美丽的季节，而你希望能领略到更绚烂的秋日风光！为此你正在努力打工，好攒钱买下一张“秋日灯光秀”的门票。在这场匆忙攒钱的打工日常里，你或许会在不知不觉间结识两位新朋友。

[摘自[url=https://fatimatorres.itch.io/autumn-days]itch.io[/url]]
